headline: A reliability release: more accurate results, sequences picked up as they change, and proper Windows wording
notes: **More accurate results.** Uses inside J-cut nests land on the right frame, dual-mono audio counts once, stacked uses inside a nest are all listed, and episodes like Ep_01 are no longer hidden as old versions.
**Keeps up with your project.** Deleted and duplicated sequences are picked up straight away, a click during a re-scan is no longer lost, and Mark all no longer triggers a full re-scan.
**Better on Windows.** Ctrl instead of Cmd in every hint, the same file recognised however its path is spelled, and the scan report keeps its line breaks.
